name: LruCache<TKey, TValue>
src_typeComment: Minimal generic LRU cache — plain C#, no Unity dependency, so it's usable (and testable) standalone of any specific asset type. TryGet touches an entry (marks it most-recently-used); Add evicts the least- recently-used entry via onEvicted once Count exceeds capacity — the caller decides what "evicted" means (e.g. Destroy a Texture2D). Used by StreamingAssetLoader, but has no dependency on it.
